init_parlai_best_response_agent: initialize a ParlAIBestResponseOrderHandler agent with a ParlAI model config and plausible order sampler
get_orders_for_power: get best Diplomacy orders for a power by sampling plausible orders and running rollouts against opponents
sample_plausible_orders: sample plausible Diplomacy orders using a PlausibleOrderSampler with an optional ParlAI model for a given game state
quantize_distribution: quantize a probability distribution into integers that sum to an exact target count using proportional rounding
run_rollouts_for_orders: run batched rollouts against opponent action distributions to find the best order from results
